dashboard.storesCopy: Only selected stores participate in automatic runs.

security.title: Your data stays on this computer
security.summary: The dashboard, settings and browser sessions run locally. The project does not operate a server that receives your credentials.
security.scope: External connections: official stores and notifications you configure.
security.honest: Credentials are stored locally in the Docker volume. When a login is needed, the automated browser sends them directly to the official store, just as a normal browser would.
security.notEncrypted: Saved secrets are not sent back to the dashboard after saving. Protect access to your Windows account and computer.

store.chooseCopy: Select the stores shown on the dashboard and included in scheduling.

settings.title: Settings
settings.storageCopy: your accounts and preferences remain on this computer.
settings.blankSecret: Leave a secret field blank to keep its current value.

sectionDescription.stores: Choose which modules appear and run automatically.
sectionDescription.browser: Configure the visual session used for logins and collections.
sectionDescription.notifications: Control summaries, alerts and external integrations.
sectionDescription.prime: Prime Gaming credentials and code redemption.
sectionDescription.steam: Credentials used by the Steam module.
sectionDescription.unity: Unity Asset Store credentials and terms.
sectionDescription.aliexpress: Credentials and limits for daily coin collection.
sectionDescription.gamerpower: Enable additional giveaway sources used by GamerPower.

epic.purpose: Used only to sign in to Epic Games and claim selected free games. It stays in your local Docker volume and is sent only to Epic's official login.

prime.purpose: Used only to sign in to Amazon Prime Gaming. It stays in your local Docker volume and is sent only to Amazon's official login.

gog.purpose: Used only to sign in to GOG and redeem eligible games or codes. It stays locally and is sent only to GOG's official login.

steam.purpose: Used only to sign in to Steam for eligible free-to-keep games. It stays locally and is sent only to Steam's official login.

ubisoft.purpose: Used only to sign in to Ubisoft. It stays locally and is sent only to Ubisoft's official login.

unity.purpose: Used only to sign in to the Unity Asset Store. It stays locally and is sent only to Unity's official login.

aliexpress.purpose: Used only to sign in to AliExpress for the daily coin check-in. It stays locally and is sent only to AliExpress's official login.

fanatical.purpose: Used only for eligible Fanatical giveaways. It stays locally and is sent only to Fanatical's official login.

itchio.purpose: Used only for eligible itch.io giveaways. It stays locally and is sent only to itch.io's official login.

indiegala.purpose: Used only for eligible IndieGala giveaways. It stays locally and is sent only to IndieGala's official login.
